agenda_briefs.title: Council to hear Happy Cities presentation on housing that connects communities
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to receive an invited presentation from Happy Cities, a planning group, about a project called 'Housing that Connects Us.' The presentation is part of a Healthy Communities - Plan H Grant Project, and speakers include a planner from Happy Cities along with City of Burnaby community planning staff. This is an information item only — no bylaw or rule change is up for a vote at this stage. If the project later leads to new housing or development rules, those would come back to Council for separate approval.
